title: IsSpell (spell flag)
html:
IsSpell is a spell flag which defines an action as a proper spell. Internally, the game uses the term "spell" for all actions. This flag is how effects like  Counterspell,  Spell Sniper,  Spell Resistance, etc. discriminate between spells and other actions.
